capabilities: Post selected text or an entire note to Bluesky
Compose posts with up to 4 image attachments and an emoji picker
Post from notes marked with type: bluesky-draft in frontmatter
Keep unsent composer text as a draft note and auto-create post history notes
Mention people with @handle and convert Markdown link syntax into real links
extras: The app password is stored in Obsidian's shared keychain (encrypted by the OS, not synced across devices) rather than data.json; full documentation lives in separate Japanese and English README files; 0BSD license.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to post a note's text to Bluesky or keep track of what was posted.
summary: Posting plugin that sends selected text or entire notes to Bluesky, with draft notes, post history, up to 4 image attachments and emoji.
